mapper.insert: insert into Users (email, password, user_name, phone_number, user_type) values (#{email}, #{password}, #{userName}, #{phoneNumber}, #{userType})
mapper.select: select user_id, email, password, user_name, phone_number, user_type, created_at, updated_at, status, suspended_until from Users where email = #{email}
select count(*) from Users where email = #{email}

select user_id, email, password, user_name, phone_number, user_type, created_at, updated_at, status, suspended_until from Users where status = 'banned' or (status = 'suspended' and suspended_until is not null and suspended_until > NOW()) order by (status = 'banned') desc, suspended_until desc
